name: Ethos

coreName.quote: the Ethos core has three releases

_notes: Original Ethos (pearl; Ethos Hybrid Oct 2024 and Ethos Solid Jun 2025 are separate balls, not written). Ethos core is symmetric. rg/diff left [] because the bowwwl 15 lb figure (RG 2.481, diff 0.053: 'At 15 lb the RG is 2.481 with a differential of 0.053') came from the core's table, not the ball page; bowling.com says 2.481/0.053 for 15 lb. Release Oct 2023 bowwwl only. Cover wording differs (Savvy Hook 4.0 Pearl vs HK22 with SH 4.0 Pearl). Finish 500/1000/1500 Siaair bowling.com only. SYMMETRIC: bowwwl.com: 'The Brunswick Ethos is a symmetric-core ball'.
